English: Gathering Room
A simple wooden shelter hastily constructed to serve as a meeting space for newcomers and settlers.
Reading Alcove
A modest annex lined with shelves and benches, encouraging literacy and the sharing of news among the townsfolk.
Meeting Chamber
A sturdier timber hall, fitted with benches and a hearth, where townsfolk gather to discuss affairs and mediate disputes.
Council Niche
A private stone chamber reserved for the city council, featuring secure archives and a dais for presiding officials.
Elders' Court
A well-built hall of stone and timber, adorned with symbols of authority, where the citys elders convene to settle important matters.
Community Archive
A fortified repository of scrolls, records, and ledgers, preserving the history and agreements of the growing city.
Debate Hall
A grand forum decorated with stone pillars and benches, designed for the assembly of citizens and spirited debate of civic issues.
Scribes Gallery
A two-story annex filled with desks and cabinets, where scribes diligently copy, translate, and preserve the citys most vital documents.
Judgement Chamber
An imposing council court, with high-backed seats and a stone dais, serving as the center for legal proceedings and arbitration.
Grand Community Hall
A sprawling stone complex crowned by a great hall, bustling with civic offices, archives, and meeting spaces for the entire city.
